text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer-kun. Let's get right 
into today's experiment—

text_block_list.name: Curly-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Tachyon-san!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh? You are...

text_block_list.name: Curly-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
My race is starting soon...! Is the potion 
that makes you faster finished yet?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right. Because of that, I took 
the liberty of looking into you a little 
bit.

text_block_list.name: Curly-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Wh-What do you mean? Why were you 
looking into me...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Hm. Could you run for a bit? There's 
something I want to confirm.

text_block_list.name: Curly-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Hah, hah... Making me run out of 
nowhere... Are you trying to say you're 
faster than me!?

text_block_list.name: Curly-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Can't you just give it to me already?! I 
don't care if it's cheating, give me the 
medicine that makes me fast—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Are you consciously focusing on the areas 
you want to improve during your training?

text_block_list.name: Curly-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Y-Yes, I am. I believe I'm suited for 
late-charging, so I'm doing training that 
fits that—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No, though I do think running as a Front 
Runner suits you better.

text_block_list.name: Curly-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Not just her reaction at the start, but 
that sheer obsession to win by any means 
necessary.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No matter how you look at it, I really 
think they're suited for Front Runner.

text_block_list.name: Curly-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
B-But... before my losing streak started, 
I even won races by closing from behind...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Weren't you just assuming that? It's 
better to keep your possibilities broad.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
From here on, how about we try training 
you as a Front Runner?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If you dwell only on past victories, you 
will only stagnate.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
As I have said before, things evolve and 
change day by day.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What you thought was right today might 
yield the exact opposite answer tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If you let your guard down, knowledge will 
become a thing of the past in the blink of 
an eye, turning into rigid stone.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Meaning physical transformation is—

text_block_list.name: Curly-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait... Then... all the training I 
pushed myself through up until now was...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You don't mean to call it "useless," do 
you? That would be thinking in far too 
extreme terms.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Are you letting your assumptions get the 
better of you? Before pushing yourself too 
hard, you should have reassessed your own 
running.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Listen, it's the speed-enhancing drugs 
that are pointless. In the first place, my 
physical modification is—
choice_data_list:
It's about constantly chasing 
possibilities, isn't it?

It's all about never giving up on 
possibilities, huh.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oops... heh-heh, you got me there.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed. Research and medicine exist to 
obtain knowledge. To answer the question 
of how to become stronger, you see."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Please do not say such trivial things like 
cheating is fine, which would completely 
nullify everything we've built up so far.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now, I have already shown you the 
possibilities! Where we go from here is up 
to you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I don't have a potion to make you faster, 
but I have something great for you! I'm 
sure it will be of great help to you!

With that, Agnes Tachyon handed over a 
transparent bag containing pills.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Phew. Dealing with the unexpected took 
some time, but it was a rare and valuable 
experience.
choice_data_list: What did you hand over earlier?
What did you hand over earlier?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Curious, are you? Heh heh... Why don't you 
try guessing?
choice_data_list: Maybe just some supplements or something?
Could it be... a new medicine...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh, I've been found out, have I?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I explained to her that it was medicine 
that doubled the effectiveness of regular 
training.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's really just a supplement, but the 
placebo effect is not to be 
underestimated.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to try it too, Trainer-kun? 
Let's see, in your case...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Drink it while bearing in mind that once 
you do, you will have no choice but to 
live the rest of your days as my 
assistant.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... Well, even if you don't drink 
it, the future won't change, I suspect.

—Afterwards, I spotted that Umamusume with 
the curly hair powerfully leading the pack 
in a mock race.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon

text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon forced me to take some 
pills...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"This medicine has the effect of making 
you dedicate your entire life to the first 
thing you see...!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now you can never escape me! You shall 
spend the rest of your life living as my 
assistant!

Even as I thought, "No way, surely not..." 
Just as I was beginning to resign myself 
to dedicating my life to Agnes Tachyon—

I spotted a curly-haired Umamusume 
powerfully leading the pack in a mock 
race.

"...By the way, apparently that medicine 
was just a supplement."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Too bad, that was just a supplement.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
All it said was that you get double the 
effects of normal training.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Come now, mindset is important too, you 
know. Setting that aside—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You mentioned sweets, and now you've given 
me a ferocious craving for them!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Chocolate would be splendid. Trainer, go 
buy some for me! Right this instant!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"For you... that's it! I'll give you a 
potion to make you run faster!"

With that, she handed me the "plain 
supplement" she had given the other girl 
earlier. Naturally, taking it didn't make 
me any faster, but—

A short while after that, I caught sight 
of a curly-haired Umamusume running 
powerfully at the head of a mock race.
